title: I published 30 AI blog posts. Traffic: zero.

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: I published thirty AI blog posts this month. Traffic? Zero.
beats.tts: [proud, then deflated] I published thirty AI blog posts this month. Traffic? [beat] Zero.

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: So you wrote thirty posts... for nobody.
beats.tts: [deadpan] So you wrote thirty posts... [beat] for nobody.

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: Let me show you how MyKavo picks what to write.
beats.tts: [laughs, then excited] Let me show you how MyKavo picks what to write!
beats.title: Meet MyKavo

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: It reads your Search Console and finds searches you already rank for on page two.
beats.tts: [confident] It reads your Search Console, and finds searches you already rank for... on page two.
beats.title: 1. Searches you can win

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: Page two? Nobody goes to page two.
beats.tts: [skeptical] Page two? Nobody goes to page two.

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: Exactly. One good post can push you to page one. Your fastest win.
beats.tts: [knowing] Exactly. One good post can push you to page one. Your fastest win.

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: Then it checks today's page one, so it knows exactly what it takes to beat them.
beats.tts: [energetic] Then it checks today's page one... so it knows exactly what it takes to beat them.
beats.title: 2. Checks page one first

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: And one click writes the whole post. Title, meta, FAQ, schema. All of it.
beats.tts: [excited] And one click writes the whole post. Title, meta, FAQ, schema. All of it!
beats.title: 3. One-click full post

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: One full post a month is free. No card.
beats.tts: [casually] One full post a month is free. No card.
beats.title: FREE plan

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: One post that ranks, versus thirty nobody reads.
beats.tts: [realizing] One post that ranks... versus thirty nobody reads.

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: Now you get it. Go delete the other twenty-nine.
beats.tts: [teasing, laughs] Now you get it. Go delete the other twenty-nine.
